newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends lower after early record high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends lower after early record high.

text.p: Jakarta share prices ended lower on Thursday on selling pressure in several blue chips after briefly touching a record high of 717.47 in the morning session, brokers said.

The composite index was off 2.69 points, or 0.38 percent, to close at 709.92 points. Losers led gainers by 65 to 60, with 72 counters unchanged. Total turnover was 781.3 rupiah billion on a volume of 334.85 million shares.
Brokers attributed heavy selling pressure of Sampoerna shares in late trading to the downturn.
